The main takeaway from our work is that

the thermodynamic and kinetic hydropower of metal-free hyrides can be tuned to a large extent by structural modifications, and that these hydrides have the potential to replace transition-metal hydrides in several catalytic applications.
the hydricity and nucleophilicity of metal-free hyrides can vary by several orders of magnitude, depending on the hydride structure and the experimental conditions.
